quests.title: Smoko
quests.summary: Carry the baker's smoko hamper out to Camp, show the manager a Johnny Rook, and win a friendly fight.

steps.text: Take the smoko hamper to the peat cutters in Camp.
Show the Camp Manager a Johnny Rook.
Beat the Camp Manager in a friendly smoko fight.

quests.reward: The Gentoo Pebble (a Frost charm), three jars of Diddle-Dee Jam and standing in the Overseas Territories.
